name: Sam Reaches the Upper Floor
description: Sam runs up the stairs and reaches the floor above.
related_events: Sam runs up the stairs to the floor above

name: Sam Rushes Down the Stairs
description: Sam rushes down the stairs, moving quickly from the upper level to the lower level.
related_events: Sam rushes down the stairs

name: Sam Moves Toward the Stairs
description: Sam looks both ways, then walks toward the stairs.
related_events: Sam checks both directions and proceeds toward the stairs

name: Sam Draws Flowing Hair on Jill's Image During Transit
description: The transport cage rattles along its elevated track toward a tower block, packed with passengers. Sam sits quietly, focused on a computer print-out of Jill. With a pencil, Sam carefully draws long, flowing hair onto the image, altering Jill's appearance.
related_events: Sam draws long flowing hair on Jill's print-out
Transport cage travels toward tower block

name: Sam Notices Exit 49, Messerschmidt Exits Just in Time
description: Sam peers at a small exit sign that reads Exit 49. Messerschmidt steers the vehicle toward the exit, leaving the arterial tunnel just as a large lorry speeds past on the main route.
related_events: Sam observes exit sign indicating exit 49
Messerschmidt takes exit 49 from arterial tunnel

name: Jill Layton confronts intruder in bathroom
description: Jill Layton is in the bathtub, washing herself while watching a portable television reflected in a mirror propped against the bath. The screen suddenly darkens as a man in uniform steps into view, his body partially blocking the TV. Startled, Jill looks up, her eyes widening. She tenses in the water and calls out, 'Who's there?'
related_events: Jill Layton watches television while bathing
Man in uniform appears and blocks television view
Jill Layton expresses fear upon seeing intruder

name: Descent to the Glowing Shopping Levels
description: The camera moves downward from the sky, where a golden sun sets behind a skyscraper crowned with a large neon sign. As the descent continues, the sunlight fades, obscured by the towering structures, and the city's artificial lights take over—neon signs flicker to life and street lamps cast their glow. Transparent transport tubes zip past, carrying quick-moving capsules, while an elevated highway hums with heavy lorries. The view settles on the upper levels of a luxurious shopping precinct, aglow with light and activity.
related_events: Sunlight is blocked out during descent to lower levels
Street lights and neon signs become primary illumination
Arrival at upper levels of plush shopping precinct

name: Sam Encounters a Broken Elevator and Takes the Stairs
description: Sam walks into the dim, run-down lobby of a large apartment building. Graffiti covers the walls, and signs of vandalism are everywhere. He approaches the elevator and presses the call button. Nothing happens. He presses it again. The elevator doors shudder and spark, then slowly grind open just a few inches, jamming in place. Through the gap, lit by flickering sparks, he sees the interior packed with trash, broken furniture, and the remains of dead animals. He pulls at the doors, but they won’t open further. Without a word, he turns away and heads toward the stairwell, beginning his climb.
related_events: Sam attempts to use malfunctioning elevator in derelict building
Sam discovers elevator interior filled with garbage and dead animals
Sam decides to take the stairs after elevator failure

name: Sam Uses His Cape to Slow His Fall
description: Sam tumbles through thick clouds, his cape twisting around his body. He struggles and pulls it free, gripping the corners before flinging it open above him. The wind catches the fabric, spreading it wide like a parachute, and his fall begins to slow. The clouds grow thinner, and the ground comes into view beneath him.
related_events: Sam plummets through dense clouds with his cape entangled
Sam frees himself from his entangled cape
Sam deploys his cape as a parachute
Clouds thin out revealing the ground below Sam

name: Girl Buttle Meets the Descending Commando
description: Girl Buttle enters her bedroom, where there is little or no light. She sees a bulky figure lowering himself from the ceiling through a hole, sliding down a pole that runs from above into the center of the room. As she moves, light from the hallway reveals the figure to be dressed like a commando on a night raid. She speaks calmly, saying, 'You've come...'
related_events: Girl Buttle enters her bedroom and encounters a figure descending from the ceiling
Commando-like figure descends into the bedroom via pole from ceiling

name: Sam Arrives at His Mother's Flat
description: Sam stands at the door of his mother's flat and presses the doorbell. The door opens to reveal a liveried flunkey, who steps aside as an attractive woman in her forties appears behind him. She smiles at Sam and says, 'Sam, I'm so glad you came. Do come in.'
related_events: Sam rings doorbell of his mother's flat
Livered flunkey opens door to Sam
Woman greets Sam at the doorway

name: Sam Navigates the Tunnel Amid Swarming Traffic
description: Sam steers his small three-wheeled car through a narrow, enclosed tunnel filled with heavy traffic. Massive buses and lorries speed past on both sides, their size and momentum forcing the tiny vehicle off the road surface. The car lurches and shakes as it is caught in the wake of the larger vehicles, jostled violently from all directions. Inside the cockpit, Sam grips the wheel, surrounded by the roar of engines and the metallic groaning of his strained vehicle. The radio plays a faint, dreamy rendition of 'Brazil' before cutting to a news bulletin about a terrorist bombing—then Sam reaches over and switches it off.
related_events: Sam drives through a congested tunnel under threat from large vehicles

name: Sam Turns Off the Radio During a News Bulletin
description: Sam drives through a long, enclosed tunnel in a small three-wheeled car, surrounded by large vehicles that jostle him as they pass. Inside the car, the radio plays an obscure version of the song 'Brazil.' Suddenly, the music cuts out and a voice announces a terrorist bombing. Before the report can continue, Sam reaches over and switches off the radio, leaving the cabin silent.
related_events: Radio broadcasts news of a terrorist bombing before being interrupted
Sam switches off the radio during a news interruption

name: Sam Reaches for the Dream Girl
description: Sam pushes through a dense tangle of thick, duct-like vines that twist and reach for him, grasping at his arms and body as he forces his way forward. Ahead, the Dream Girl hovers just out of reach, her face visible through the snarled growth. He breaks free from the last of the vines and reaches out to embrace her, but the moment his hands touch her, she dissolves into smoke. The ground gives way beneath him, and he falls into the darkness below.
related_events: Sam struggles through vine-like conduits while being grabbed and entangled
Sam reaches out to embrace Dream Girl but she dissolves into smoke

name: Sam Reaches the Dream Girl and Falls into the Void
description: As Sam reaches out and embraces the Dream Girl, she dissolves into smoke. The ground beneath him gives way, and he plunges into a dark void below.
related_events: Sam plummets into a void beneath him after Dream Girl's disappearance

name: Arrival at the Platform and Disembarkation
description: The transport cage comes to a stop at the platform. Passengers step out and begin walking toward various doors along the corridor. One man, SAM, lingers momentarily, then follows the others, heading toward his own front door.
related_events: Transport cage arrives at platform
Passengers disembark from transport cage

name: SAM nearly misses the exit and walks home hesitantly
description: The transport cage arrives at the platform at the end of SAM's corridor. Passengers step off and move toward various doors along the corridor. SAM remains inside, still looking at JILL's picture, and only just manages to get off before the doors close. He walks toward his front door, moving slowly, as if uncertain about something.
related_events: SAM nearly misses disembarking in time
SAM heads toward his front door while appearing indecisive

name: The Buttle Family's Christmas Evening
description: The television screen shows end credits rolling over Helpmann and the Interviewer, set to a Mozart theme. The camera pulls back to reveal the room beyond the screen: a sitting room decorated for Christmas with tinsel and lights. Thick metal conduits snake across the walls, breaking through the plaster, branching into smaller pipes and cables that connect to the walls, floor, and various appliances. The conduits bear the label Central Services. Mrs. Buttle sits with Girl Buttle, who listens as her mother reads from a copy of Dickens' Christmas Carol. Boy Buttle plays quietly on the floor, aiming a toy machine gun at action figures dressed in security uniforms. Mr. Buttle finishes wrapping a small box, placing the ribbon with care. Outside, faint laughter rises from the floor above.
related_events: Sitting room revealed with Christmas decorations and intrusive metal conduits
TV broadcast concludes with end credits over Helpmann and Interviewer

name: The Buttle Family on Christmas Eve
description: Mrs. Buttle sits with Girl Buttle, reading from a book of Christmas stories. Girl Buttle listens quietly, eyes fixed on her mother. Nearby, Boy Buttle crouches on the floor, moving toy soldiers in security uniforms through mock maneuvers, a plastic machine gun in hand. Mr. Buttle adjusts the ribbon on a small, neatly wrapped gift, placing it carefully beside the others under the tree. The room is lit by the glow of the television, where the credits of a show roll over two figures, accompanied by a classical tune. Outside, a burst of laughter drifts down from the floor above.
related_events: Mrs. Buttle reads Christmas Carol to Girl Buttle
Boy Buttle plays with toy machine gun and security action figures
Mr. Buttle finishes wrapping a Christmas present

name: Sam Finds the Flat Ransacked
description: Sam bursts into Jill's flat and sees a hole in the floor. The apartment is in disarray, appearing long abandoned. Dust covers the surfaces, and broken objects are scattered across the room.
related_events: Sam bursts into Jill's flat
Sam discovers hole in the floor of Jill's flat

name: Sam Sees Car Explode and Jill Fleeing with Suitcase
description: Sam bursts into Jill's flat and sees a hole in the floor. The place looks derelict. An explosion sounds near the forecourt. He rushes to the window and sees his car engulfed in flames. Outside, Jill is moving quickly across the forecourt, carrying a suitcase and bundles, moving away from the burning car.
related_events: Explosion occurs near forecourt
Sam sees his car on fire
Jill retreats from burning car across forecourt
Jill carries suitcase and bundles while fleeing

name: Sam Corrects Billing Error Between Buttle and Tuttle
description: Kurtzman watches anxiously as Sam works at the console, scanning through records. The system keeps pulling up old films, and Kurtzman suggests the machine might be malfunctioning. Sam dismisses the idea, pointing to a mismatch in personnel code numbers. He locates the error: an electrical procedures charge meant for Tuttle, Archibald, a heating engineer, has been applied to Buttle, Archibald, a shoe repair operative. Sam traces the confusion to conflicting submissions—one from Expediting for Buttle, another from Security invoicing Admin for Tuttle. As Sam corrects the entry, updating the account with the proper code and charge, Kurtzman expresses relief that the mistake lies with Information Retrieval, not them.
related_events: Kurtzman suggests machine malfunction due to repeated film detection
Sam identifies personnel code number mismatch in system
Sam corrects data entry error between Buttle and Tuttle accounts
Kurtzman expresses relief that the error is not their responsibility

name: Sam Learns of His Promotion and Reacts to the News
description: Kurtzman tells Sam that he has been promoted and transferred to Information Retrieval, handing him an official notice. Sam reads the paper in silence, his expression darkening. He mutters, "What a BITCH!" under his breath, clearly angered by the news. Kurtzman suggests it might be Sam's mother pulling strings, and Sam does not deny it, his frustration evident as he crumples the notice.
related_events: Kurtzman informs Sam of his promotion and transfer
Sam reassures Kurtzman about declining a potential promotion
Sam reacts angrily upon learning about the promotion

name: Sam Approaches Mrs Buttle's Flat on the 37th Floor
description: Sam emerges breathlessly from the stairwell onto the 37th floor. He walks down the corridor, sees the number 37 on the wall, and moves toward the door. As he raises his hand to knock, he notices the door is already cracked open. The door begins to swing inward, disrupting his knock, and he ends up tapping feebly on the door frame. 'Mrs Buttle?' he calls. There is no answer. He calls again, still no response. Carefully, he pushes the door further open and steps partially into the hallway of the flat, his body only partly inside.
related_events: Sam exits stairwell breathlessly on floor 37
Sam notices door is cracked open while attempting to knock
Sam knocks feebly on door frame due to door swinging open
Sam calls out to Mrs Buttle with no response
Sam cautiously enters Mrs Buttle's flat with partial body exposure

name: Sam Observes the Darkened Hallway
description: Sam pushes the door open slightly and steps partially into the flat, his body hovering in the threshold. From inside, he looks down the dimly lit hallway, the shadows stretching across the walls and floor. He remains still, taking in the quiet and the darkness.
related_events: Sam observes darkened hallway from inside the flat

name: Technician Sorts Paperwork in Clinical Office
description: A TV plays in the background with Helpmann speaking about information retrieval charges. The camera reveals a technician in a clinical office, sorting through a stack of paperwork on his desk. Among the documents are several Christmas cards. He moves through the stack methodically, handling each item without comment.
related_events: Camera reveals technician in clinical office sorting paperwork
Technician handles Christmas cards among work documents
Helpmann speaks about information retrieval charges on television

name: Technician Opens Christmas Package
description: A white-coated technician sorts through paperwork on his desk, surrounded by a stack of documents and several Christmas cards. Among the files, he finds a Christmassy package and rips it open. Inside, he discovers a shiny, metal executive toy.
related_events: Character discovers executive toy in Christmas package

name: Technician Swats at Buzzing Beetle
description: The technician, sorting paperwork at his desk, hears a buzzing sound. A beetle circles the fluorescent light above him. He picks up a stack of paper forms, rolls them into a tube, and stands up, swatting at the insect.
related_events: Technician attempts to swat beetle buzzing near fluorescent light

name: Sam Answers the Phone and Deals with a Malfunctioning Alarm
description: The telephone rings in the darkened room. A hand reaches for the receiver. Sam, in bed, lifts it to his ear, speaking groggily. He recognizes Mr. Kurtzman’s voice and remarks on the late hour. As they talk, Sam notices the electronic device by his bed is malfunctioning. He hits it to stop the alarm, but the impact triggers a chain of events: the window shutters roll open, letting in morning light; the taps in the bathroom turn on; the coffee maker in the kitchen begins brewing; the television in the sitting room switches on; and in the bedroom, a cupboard door pops open, revealing a rack of clothes sliding out. Sam sets down the phone, gets up, and moves through the apartment, turning off the bath taps before starting to dress. He pauses to fix a loose film poster on the wall, pushing the pin in firmly. The coffee finishes brewing as he pours a cup and leaves the apartment.
related_events: Sam answers late-night phone call from Mr. Kurtzman
Sam attempts to turn off malfunctioning alarm clock

name: Sam Navigates a Malfunctioning Morning Routine
description: The telephone rings in the darkened room. Sam stirs in bed, fumbling for the receiver. He speaks groggily into the phone, addressing Mr. Kurtzman. An electronic alarm device beside him blares. Sam hits it, but the impact triggers a cascade of automated actions: the window shutters roll open, flooding the room with morning light; the bathroom taps turn on; the coffee maker in the kitchen begins brewing; the television in the sitting room switches on. A cupboard in the bedroom pops open, and a clothing rack slides out, offering his suit. The suit moves toward him as he gets up. He notices a loose film poster on the wall and pushes the pin back in. He enters the bathroom, turns off the running taps, and returns to dress. In the kitchen, he pours a cup of coffee from the freshly brewed pot. He takes the cup, heads to the door, and leaves. The apartment, lined with uniform metal panels and marked with Central Services logos, remains behind him, its systems still erratic.
related_events: Automated systems activate uncontrollably in Sam's apartment
Sam prepares for work amid electronic malfunctions

name: Sam's Morning Routine and Departure
description: Sam turns off the bathroom taps and steps out of the bathroom. He notices a loose film poster on the wall and pushes the pin in firmly to secure it. In the kitchen, he pours a cup of coffee from a freshly brewed pot. He takes the cup, walks to the door, and leaves the apartment.
related_events: Sam turns off bathroom taps and exits bathroom
Sam fixes loose film poster before leaving
Sam pours coffee and leaves apartment

name: Running and Hesitating in the Corridor
description: He runs along the corridor, then slows, unsure which door to choose. He stops, glances from side to side, and hesitates. After a moment, he steps toward one door.
related_events: Character runs along the corridor uncertain of the correct door
Character hesitates before choosing a door

name: Banging on the Door After Bell Fails
description: He rings the doorbell, but there is no response. He bangs on the door. It opens a crack, and a malevolent eye looks out at him. The door shuts firmly.
related_events: Doorbell fails to function
Character bangs on the door
Door opens slightly revealing a malevolent eye

name: The Door Closes, Sam Moves On
description: The door opens a crack, revealing a malevolent eye. It shuts firmly. Sam turns and rushes to the next door.
related_events: Door shuts firmly after brief encounter
SAM rushes to the next door

name: Closing the Book and Preparing for Bed
description: Mrs Buttle closes the book and says it is time to sleep. She tells the children that Father Christmas won’t come on Christmas Eve if they don’t get plenty of rest. The girl gives her parents a goodnight kiss and starts to leave the room. She stops and asks how Father Christmas will get down from upstairs. The boy tells her it’s a secret. They follow the girl out of the sitting room.
related_events: Mrs Buttle closes the book and suggests bedtime

name: Girl Buttle Asks How Father Christmas Will Enter
description: The girl buttle stops before leaving the sitting room and says Father Christmas can't come if they don't have a chimney. Her mother closes the book and tells her, 'You'll see.' The girl then asks how he will get down from upstairs, but the boy buttle only replies that it's a secret. She exchanges goodnight kisses with her parents and follows the boy out of the room.
related_events: Girl Buttle expresses concern about Father Christmas entering without a chimney
Girl Buttle receives reassurance from Mrs Buttle

name: Goodnight Kisses and Leaving the Sitting Room
description: The Girl Buttle leans in and kisses her parents goodnight. She turns and leaves the sitting room, walking out into the hallway as the door remains open behind her.
related_events: Girl Buttle exchanges goodnight kisses with her parents

name: Girl Asks About Father Christmas and Brother Keeps a Secret
description: After leaving the sitting room, the girl stops and asks how Father Christmas will get to her room upstairs. Her brother looks at her and says it is a secret, then turns and continues down the hall without explaining.
related_events: Girl Buttle asks how Father Christmas will reach the upstairs room
Boy Buttle claims knowledge of a secret about Father Christmas

name: Sam and Neighbour Notice Kurtzman's Open Door
description: Sam sits at his desk surrounded by clerks scrambling to handle a constant flow of documents arriving through vacuum tubes. Screens flash with data, and the office hums with urgent activity. At the next desk, his neighbour leans over and mutters that Kurtzman is acting suspiciously. Sam asks what they have on for the day. The neighbour replies, 'Casablanca.' Then Kurtzman appears in the doorway of his office and calls out, 'Mr. Lowry! Would you step in here a moment please?' He turns and goes back inside, closing the door behind him.
related_events: Clerks work busily at their desks
Neighbour expresses suspicion about Kurtzman

name: Sam Asks About the Day's Work
description: Sam sits at his desk surrounded by the constant movement of documents arriving through vacuum tubes. Clerks around him are busy, and the screens display their usual activity. Mr. Kurtzman’s office door is open, adding to the sense of urgency. At the neighboring desk, another clerk watches the activity. Sam turns to him and asks what they are working on today. The neighbor replies, 'Casablanca.'
related_events: Sam inquires about the day's assignment
Neighbour informs Sam about working on Casablanca

name: Sam and the Clerks Process Documents Under Kurtzman's Watch
description: Sam sits at his desk among a row of clerks, all surrounded by a constant flow of documents arriving through vacuum tubes. Papers shoot in from all directions, and the clerks move quickly, sorting and processing each one. At the next desk, Sam’s neighbour glances toward Kurtzman’s office. The door is wide open, and Kurtzman stands in the doorway. He calls out, 'Mr Lowry! Would you step in here a moment please.' As Kurtzman turns and closes the office door behind him, the clerks continue their work without pause.
related_events: Office staff process documents through vacuum tubes
Clerks work busily at their desks

name: Kurtzman Summons Lowry to His Office
description: Kurtzman appears in the doorway of his office and calls out for Mr. Lowry. He waits as Lowry rises from his desk, then steps back inside, closing the door behind them.
related_events: Kurtzman calls Lowry into his office

name: Sam Helps Mr Helpmann After the Lavatory
description: Sam holds Mr Helpmann under the armpits as he zips his fly, then lowers him into the wheelchair. While maneuvering him, Sam accidentally knocks over a small pot on the bathroom shelf, spilling a thin layer of powder across the wash-stand. He apologizes. Mr Helpmann speaks about his friendship with Sam’s father, tracing the letters EREIAMJH in the powder. He says he keeps Sam’s father’s name alive at the office. Sam hesitates, then says he’s changed his mind about the transfer. Mr Helpmann asks if he’s too late, then offers his hand. Sam takes it. Mr Helpmann welcomes him to Information Retrieval and blows the powder—and the traced letters—away.
related_events: Sam assists Mr Helpmann with using the bathroom

name: Sam Knocks Over a Pot in Mother's Bathroom
description: While helping Mr Helpmann into the wheelchair, Sam stumbles and knocks over one of the decorative pots on Mother's bathroom shelf. The pot falls, spilling a thin layer of powder across the washstand. Sam apologizes. Mr Helpmann, still seated, begins tracing letters in the dust with his finger.
related_events: Sam knocks over a decorative pot in Mother's bathroom

name: Mr Helpmann Remembers Jeremiah
description: In MOTHER's bathroom, the pink or purple lavatory flushes as SAM holds MR HELPMANN upright, helping him zip his fly before lowering him into the wheelchair. While maneuvering, SAM knocks over one of the decorative pots on the shelf, spilling a thin layer of powder across the wash-stand. HELPMANN thanks SAM and begins to speak about his past. He recalls his close friendship with SAM's father, Jeremiah, especially after the bombing that injured his legs. He chuckles as he mentions keeping Jeremiah’s name alive at the office, saying it’s as though Jeremiah is still there, speaking to him—"'ere I am, J.H.!" Using his finger, he traces the letters EREIAMJH in the powder. He tells SAM he had promised SAM’s mother to help him join the team at Information Retrieval. SAM interrupts, saying he’s changed his mind and wants to accept the transfer. HELPMANN smiles, extends his hand, and welcomes SAM to Information Retrieval. He then blows the powder off the wash-stand, scattering the letters he had traced.
related_events: Mr Helpmann shares memories of Jeremiah with Sam
Mr Helpmann traces letters in powder on the washstand

name: Sam Accepts Transfer to Information Retrieval
description: The pink or purple lavatory finishes flushing as Sam holds Mr Helpmann under the armpits, helping him zip his fly before lowering him into the wheelchair. In the process, Sam knocks over one of the decorative pots on Mother's bathroom shelf, spilling a thin layer of powder across the wash-stand. He mutters an apology. Mr Helpmann speaks of his friendship with Sam's father, Jeremiah, recalling their closeness, especially after the bombing that injured him. He traces letters in the powder—EREIAMJH—chuckling as he imagines Jeremiah's voice: "'ere I am, J.H.!" The ghost in the machine. He says he had promised Sam’s mother to get him onto the team at Information Retrieval, but understands there may have been hesitation. Sam interrupts, saying he’s changed his mind and wants to accept the transfer—asking if he’s too late. Mr Helpmann replies that it’s for him to decide, then extends his hand. Sam takes it. Mr Helpmann welcomes him to Information Retrieval. He then blows across the wash-stand, scattering the spilled powder and erasing the letters from the surface.
related_events: Sam decides to accept the transfer to Information Retrieval
Mr Helpmann welcomes Sam to Information Retrieval
Mr Helpmann blows away the spilled powder and erases EREIAMJH from the washstand

name: Interviewer Challenges Helpmann Over Terrorism Remarks
description: On a bank of television screens in a shop window, Deputy Minister Helpmann appears in a live interview, speaking calmly as shoppers pass by. The interviewer asks what he believes is behind the recent rise in terrorist bombings. Helpmann responds that it stems from bad sportsmanship, describing the perpetrators as a ruthless minority who cannot stand to see others win, comparing them to hecklers on the sidelines of a game. The interviewer interrupts, clarifying, 'In fact, killing people.' Helpmann repeats the phrase without pause, then continues, suggesting these individuals would benefit from simply playing the game. The interviewer presses further, questioning whether the Ministry of Information has grown too large, citing that its cost amounts to seven percent of the gross national product. Helpmann replies that in a free society, information is essential, and one cannot win if they are a man short. As he speaks, fur-clad shoppers move past the storefront, oblivious. Behind them, what first appears to be snow is revealed to be fire-fighting foam spilling from a charred, ruined shop, its entrance being boarded up by workmen. A band dressed in red and white, calling themselves Consumers For Christ, plays Christmas carols nearby. Children line up at Santa’s grotto as the interview continues, the sound of Helpmann’s voice blending into the festive noise.
related_events: Deputy Minister Helpmann gives interview on television about terrorist bombings
Interviewer challenges Helpmann on downplaying violence of terrorist acts

name: Shoppers Pass Damaged Shop During Holiday Season
description: Shoppers move through the city streets, browsing in stores adorned with holiday decorations and carrying elaborately packaged goods. Strings of lights and festive displays line the sidewalks. A Salvation Army-style band called Consumers For Christ plays Christmas carols nearby. In front of a charred storefront oozing white firefighting foam, workmen nail plywood sheets across the broken entrance. The shoppers walk past without stopping, their eyes on the festive displays, while the band continues to play and Santa’s grotto hums with activity just a few steps away.
related_events: Shoppers browse and purchase holiday goods in decorated city shops
Shoppers walk past fire-damaged shop covered in firefighting foam
Workmen seal damaged shop front with plywood sheets

name: Consumers For Christ Band Plays Carols Amid Holiday Shopping
description: A band called Consumers For Christ plays Christmas carols in the shopping district. Dressed in red and white uniforms reminiscent of Salvation Army musicians, they stand near a busy sidewalk, performing festive songs as shoppers pass by. The music blends with the sounds of the crowd and the jingle of cash registers from nearby stores. Shoppers carrying shopping bags pause briefly, some dropping coins into an open instrument case, while others continue on without breaking stride. The band plays on, surrounded by glittering store windows and holiday displays, as foam oozes from the blackened remains of a nearby shop sealed behind plywood boards.
related_events: Consumers For Christ band plays Christmas carols near shopping area

name: SAM Arrives at the Housing Tower
description: SAM pulls up beside the massive, grey housing tower in his Messerschmidt. The building looms above him, its surface marked by decay and vandalism, framed by large conduits and pipes. He steps out of the car and stands beneath the cool, unfriendly stares of a few locals. Holding a piece of paper in his hand, he looks around, then down at the paper, checking its contents as he takes in his surroundings.
related_events: SAM arrives at the base of the decrepit housing tower
SAM consults a paper after exiting the car

name: SAM Asks Kids for Directions
description: SAM walks over to a group of kids sitting against a wall, where they are playing a game with coins. He takes out a piece of paper and speaks to them, but before he can finish his question, the smallest child looks up and tells him to eff off. SAM hesitates, shifts awkwardly, and then turns away, walking back toward the building. As he leaves, one of the kids stands up and moves toward his car, while another fiddles with a box of matches.
related_events: SAM approaches the kids to ask a question
Smallest kid tells SAM to go away
SAM uncomfortably walks away after being dismissed

name: Kids Approach Car with Can and Matches
description: After SAM entered the building, one of the children stood up and walked over to his car, holding a can. At the same time, another kid crouched nearby, pulling out a box of matches and turning it over in their hands.
related_events: One kid approaches SAM's car with a can
Another kid fiddles with a box of matches

name: The Girl in the Butler's Uniform
description: As SAM approaches a group of kids playing by the wall, a small girl dressed in a butler's uniform stands apart, watching him without expression. She remains still and silent while SAM speaks to the children, her eyes following his movements. When he turns away and walks toward the building, she does not look away.
related_events: Girl butler silently observes SAM from a distance

name: Kids Playing Pitching Pennies
description: A small group of children sits against a wall, playing a game of pitching pennies. They flick coins at the concrete, watching them bounce and clatter. One of them retrieves a coin, checks it, and tosses it back into the game. They are focused on the play, their movements quick and practiced, when SAM approaches.
related_events: Kids play pitching pennies against a wall

name: Stamp the Receipt and Reveal the Office
description: A pink receipt is stamped and impaled on a desk spike. The camera pulls back to reveal an endless expanse of metal desks arranged in strict rows. Each desk is occupied by a clerk and buried under piles of paper. Built-in TV consoles sit on every desk, and pneumatic tubes periodically deliver more paperwork. Office boys move quickly between desks with additional documents. The clerks work steadily under the supervision of Mr. Kurtzman, who walks along an elevated platform overseeing the room. He enters his glass-walled office at the top of the space, and the door closes behind him.
related_events: Receipt is stamped and impaled on desk spike
Camera reveals infinite office space with clerks at metal desks

name: Paperwork Delivered Through Pneumatic Tubes and by Office Boys
description: Pneumatic tubes release new stacks of paperwork onto the desks, each one joining the growing piles already covering the surfaces. Office boys move quickly between the rows of metal desks, carrying armloads of additional documents. Each clerk sits before a built-in television console that displays shifting graphs, numbers, and figures, the screens glowing under the fluorescent light.
related_events: Pneumatic tubes deliver new paperwork to desks
Office boys carry more paperwork through the room
Television consoles display graphs and figures

name: Mr. Kurtzman Supervises Clerks and Enters Private Office
description: Mr. Kurtzman walks along an elevated walkway overlooking a vast room filled with metal desks, each occupied by a clerk buried in paperwork. Television consoles at each station display shifting graphs and figures. Satisfied with what he sees, he turns and proceeds to the top of the room, entering a glass-enclosed office. His name is visible on the frosted glass door as he closes it behind him.
related_events: Mr. Kurtzman supervises clerks from elevated walkway
Mr. Kurtzman walks to his glass-enclosed private office

name: Clerks Switch to Film After Kurtzman's Exit
description: As Mr. Kurtzman closes the door to his private office, the clerks at their desks immediately stop working. Each one reaches for a switch and changes their TV screen, all now displaying a film that resembles 'The Good, The Bad And The Ugly'. The screens glow with the same images, showing cowboys and desert landscapes, while the office remains silent and still beneath the elevated walkway.
related_events: Mr. Kurtzman closes door and clerks stop working
Clerks switch TV screens to watch film

name: Kurtzman and Sam Address the Missing Transporter and Buttle's Cheque
description: At the end of the workday, the clerks gather their coats and leave the office. Mr. Kurtzman emerges from his private office, hat and coat on, and turns off the light behind him. He notices Sam still seated at his console, absorbed in his work. On the computer screen is a front and side view of a woman named Jill, with her code number and personal details listed. Kurtzman asks Sam if he knows anything about a missing personnel transporter. Sam, distracted, corrects him—it was a personal transporter, not personnel—and says he’ll handle the paperwork tomorrow. Kurtzman then asks about Mrs. Buttle’s cheque. Sam confirms he delivered it. Kurtzman asks if he can consider the matter closed. Sam says yes. Kurtzman expresses relief, then notices the classified label flashing on Sam’s screen along with the code "IRQ/3". Sam curses. Kurtzman reminds him that all information on third-level suspects is classified and that Information Retrieval won’t help. As Sam works at the console, canceling the overprint and initiating a printout, Kurtzman picks up the paper when it emerges—Jill’s two-view portrait—and quickly drops it, shuddering. Sam considers accepting a promotion to gain access to the information. Kurtzman says yes, then immediately objects, realizing what he’s agreed to. He reminds Sam he already signed the promotion form on his behalf. Sam protests, saying he never signed it. Kurtzman insists he did it for him. Sam hesitates, unsure. Kurtzman urges him to leave before the lights go out. Sam shuts down the machine, stands, and follows Kurtzman toward the door. The lights cut out before they reach it. Kurtzman stumbles into a desk and curses.
related_events: Mr. Kurtzman confronts Sam about a missing personnel transporter
Sam delivers Mrs. Buttle's cheque

name: Sam Retrieves Jill's Classified File
description: At the end of the workday, as the other clerks leave, Sam remains at his console, absorbed in his work. On the screen appears a front and side view of Jill, with her name and code number at the top. Sam enters details such as age, height, weight, hair and eye color, and distinguishing marks. A warning appears on the screen—'Classified' overlays most of the file, and 'IRQ/3' flashes repeatedly at the bottom. Sam curses under his breath. He quickly cancels the overprint, bypasses the security alert, and inputs a command for a hard-copy printout. A moment later, Jill's two-view portrait rolls out of the machine. He pauses, studying the print as it lies on the desk.
related_events: Sam accesses and modifies Jill's classified dossier
Sam bypasses security overprint to print Jill's portrait

name: Sam Learns Kurtzman Signed His Promotion Papers
description: At the end of the workday, the clerks leave the office, and Mr. Kurtzman emerges from his private room, preparing to leave. He notices Sam still at his computer, focused on the screen displaying a front and side view of a woman named Jill, along with personal details like age, height, hair color, and eye color. Kurtzman asks if Sam knows about a missing personnel transporter, but Sam, distracted, corrects him—it was a personal transporter, and he’ll handle the paperwork tomorrow. Kurtzman inquires about Mrs. Buttle’s cheque, and Sam confirms he delivered it. Relieved, Kurtzman says he can finally put the matter behind him, though he might still have nightmares. On the screen, the word "Classified" appears over most of the information, and "IRQ/3" flashes at the bottom. Sam curses under his breath. Kurtzman asks what’s wrong, and Sam asks if he knows how to bypass an IRQ/3. Kurtzman replies that all information on third-level suspects is classified and that Information Retrieval won’t help. While Kurtzman speaks, Sam works at the console, canceling the classified overlay and initiating a hard-copy printout. Jill’s image prints and rolls out of the machine. Sam cuts Kurtzman off, saying he’ll have to accept the promotion to get access. Kurtzman agrees, then immediately protests, realizing what he’s admitted. He reveals he already submitted the form for Sam. Sam is stunned, demanding to know when. Kurtzman says he did it because it was what Sam wanted. Sam hesitates, unsure. Kurtzman picks up the printed image of Jill, grimaces, and drops it as if it disturbed him. He urges Sam to leave before the lights go out. Sam turns off the console, stands, and follows. As they walk toward the distant door, the lights cut out. Kurtzman stumbles into a desk and curses in the dark.
related_events: Sam considers accepting a promotion to advance his goal
Kurtzman reveals he submitted Sam's promotion form

name: Kurtzman Reacts to Jill's Portrait and Both Men Leave in Darkness
description: Kurtzman picked up the printed portrait of Jill, glanced at it, and grimaced. He dropped the paper onto the desk with a shudder. Sam turned off his computer console, stood up, and followed Kurtzman toward the door. The two walked across the darkening office, but before they reached the exit, the lights went out. Kurtzman stumbled into a desk and cursed as the room fell into complete darkness.
related_events: Kurtzman reacts to Jill's print-out with discomfort
Sam shuts down his computer console before leaving
Lights go out as Sam and Kurtzman attempt to leave the office

name: Clearing the Flat After the Raid
description: The troops leave the room below by climbing up through the hole in the floor. A security man pushes Bill and Jill aside as he moves to the center of the room. He removes the fireman's pole from the hole and carries it away. Another security man unties the rope hanging out of the open window and coils it neatly. Once the equipment is removed, the two security men exit the flat, leaving Bill and Jill behind.
related_events: Troops exit room below through hole in floor
Bill and Jill are pushed aside by security man
Security men clear fireman's pole and remove rope from flat

name: Charlie and Bill Take Control
description: Charlie steps back from the hole in the floor and calls out, identifying himself, Bill, and Jill as Department of Works personnel. Security men push past them, removing the fireman's pole and untying a rope from the window before coiling it neatly and leaving. Bill watches the operation and tells Jill not to take any notice, explaining that the security team’s behavior is due to their training, though he adds they are the best in the world. Jill asks Bill who he is. Charlie assures her not to worry, saying they will have everything in order soon. Bill agrees, telling her there is nothing to be concerned about. Charlie adds that it is Mr. Buttle downstairs who should be worried. Jill protests that there must be a mistake, insisting Mr. Buttle is harmless. Bill responds that they do not make mistakes. As he speaks, he drops the manhole cover into the hole, and it slips through the floor into the flat below.
related_events: Charlie identifies himself and Jill as Department of Works personnel
Bill reassures Jill about security team behavior
Jill questions identity and motives of Bill and Charlie
Charlie claims responsibility for restoring order
Bill asserts authority by denying possibility of error
Charlie implies Mr. Buttle is the one in trouble

name: Bill Drops the Manhole Cover
description: Bill lifts the manhole cover, which is faced with the same material as the floor, and lowers it into place over the hole. Instead of settling, the cover slips through the opening and disappears into the flat below. The sound of it falling echoes upward as the space above the hole empties, leaving only the open shaft.
related_events: Bill drops manhole cover through floor into flat below

name: Mrs Buttle Collapses as Jill Calls Out
description: In the flat below, Mrs Buttle stands motionless amidst the wreckage. The children cry around her. She looks at the receipt in her hand, then slowly sinks to the floor, collapsing in silence. From off-camera, Jill's voice calls out, 'Mrs Buttle? Mrs Buttle?'
related_events: Mrs Buttle collapses in her decimated flat after receiving receipt
Jill calls out to Mrs Buttle off-camera

name: Technician Swats Beetle, Carcass Falls into Typewriter
description: The Technician climbs onto a chair balanced on his desk to reach a beetle buzzing near the ceiling. As he swats at it, he wobbles, struggling to keep his balance. With a final strike, he hits the beetle, squashing it against the ceiling. He climbs down, unaware that the beetle’s carcass loosens and drops into the automatic typewriter below. The machine hiccoughs, types a single 'B', then resumes its steady rhythm.
related_events: Technician climbs chair to swat beetle
Technician loses balance while swatting beetle on ceiling
Beetle's carcass falls into automatic typewriter

name: The Beetle's Carcass Disrupts the Typewriter
description: The TECHNICIAN climbs down from the chair balanced on his desk after swatting the BEETLE, which lies squashed against the ceiling. Moments later, the beetle's carcass loosens and drops silently into the automatic typewriter. The machine hiccoughs, hesitates, and types the letter "B." It pauses, then continues typing, producing the name "BUTTLE, Archibald" on a separate sheet of paper. The sheet joins the others in the holding basket, each bearing a name beginning with T, now followed by this one beginning with B. The machine resumes its rhythm, typing the next names: TUTWOOD, Thomas T. ... TUZCZLOW, Peter...
related_events: Beetle's carcass falls into automatic typewriter
Automatic typewriter types letter B after beetle interference
Automatic typewriter compiles incorrect name due to beetle contamination

name: The Typing Machine Produces a List
description: A typewriter clatters steadily, typing a series of names under the heading 'Information Retrieval, Subjects For Detention & Interview'. Each name begins with the letter T: TONSTED, Simon ... TOPPER, Martin F. ... TROLLOPE, Benjamin G. ... TURB, William K. ... TURNER, John D. The machine feeds from a spool of paper that advances through an automatic guillotine, which cuts each completed name into a separate sheet. The sheets fall one by one into a holding basket, each carrying the heading and a single name, neatly severed from the next. The process continues without interruption: TUTWOOD, Thomas T. ... TUZCZLOW, Peter ...
related_events: Automatic typewriter compiles list of names for detention
Guillotine cuts paper spool into individual sheets

name: Helpmann Claims Government Victory in Interview
description: Deputy Minister Helpmann sits for a broadcast interview where he states the government is winning the battle against terrorists. He describes their morale as high and uses a cricket metaphor, saying they are fielding the enemy's strokes, running many of them out, and consistently knocking them for six. The interviewer notes the bombing campaign has lasted thirteen years, to which Helpmann responds it was only beginner's luck. The interviewer thanks Helpmann, who replies, 'Thank you, David... and a very merry Christmas to you all.'
related_events: Helpmann claims government is winning against terrorists
Interviewer concludes interview with Deputy Minister
Helpmann delivers holiday greeting after interview

name: The Doctor Demonstrates the Facelift
description: The Doctor grips Mrs Lowry's cheeks, pulling the skin taut to show how tight and smooth her face can become. He stretches the flesh around to the back of her neck, holding it in place to demonstrate the effect. Then, he takes a set of coloured markers from his pocket and begins drawing lines across her face—along the jaw, under the eyes, and up the forehead—marking each area where he will make adjustments. With quick strokes, he outlines the changes, explaining as he goes. Finally, he applies strips of cellophane over the marked zones, securing them with tape. Sam watches, silent at first, then mutters, 'My God, it works.'
related_events: Doctor demonstrates facelift technique on Mrs Lowry
Doctor marks Mrs Lowry's face with coloured markers for facelift surgery

name: The Doctor Wraps Mrs Lowry's Face in Cellophane
description: After drawing colored lines across Mrs Lowry's face with markers, the Doctor pulls a sheet of cellophane from his pocket and carefully wraps it around her head. He smooths the plastic over her cheeks, forehead, and jawline, then secures it tightly with strips of cellotape. The cellophane pulls her skin taut, lifting the wrinkles and reshaping her features into a stiff, glossy mask. Sam stares in silence, his expression shifting from disgust to stunned disbelief. He takes a step back and mutters, 'My God, it works.'
related_events: Doctor applies cellophane and tape to shape Mrs Lowry's face
Sam reacts with shock and amazement to the transformation

name: Sam Confronts His Mother During Cosmetic Consultation
description: In the doctor's surgery, Sam paces angrily as his mother sits at the dressing table, the doctor standing behind her. Sam argues with her about ambition, insisting he doesn't want promotion and telling her to stop interfering. His mother counters that he lacks drive and cites Jack Lint as an example, mentioning Mr Helpmann as someone who was almost successful. The doctor interrupts, telling Sam to wait in reception, saying his presence is giving Mrs Lowry wrinkles. Sam groans but steps out of the room. The doctor then resumes his examination, reassuring Mrs Lowry and promising to make her look decades younger.
related_events: Sam argues with his mother about ambition and promotion
Doctor instructs Sam to wait in reception

name: Mrs Lowry Praises Doctor Jaffe
description: After Sam leaves the room, Mrs Lowry looks at Doctor Jaffe with admiration. She calls him a genius and laughs as she tells him he should be Surgeon General—Four Star. She adds that she knows everyone, her voice full of confidence and approval.
related_events: Mrs Lowry praises Doctor Jaffe and offers him high-ranking position

name: Sam Wakes to a Ringing Doorbell
description: Sam wakes up on the floor of his damaged sitting room, his feet tangled in wires and ducting. He begins to untangle himself when the doorbell rings. Startled, he pauses, then gets to his feet and walks to the door.
related_events: Sam wakes up entangled in wiring and ducting
Doorbell rings startling Sam
Sam gets up and goes to the door

name: Girl Delivers Singing Telegram to Sam
description: A girl dressed in a glittery bell-boy costume, with net stockings, big-bowed tap shoes, and a flurry of energy, bursts through the door and launches into a loud, off-key song and dance. She spins and taps unevenly, announcing that Mrs. Ida Lowry requests Sam's presence at her apartment for a celebration of her recent cosmetic surgery, with Mr. Conrad Helpmann as guest of honor. The performance, abrupt and slightly chaotic, ends with a stiff pause. Sam, standing barefoot amid scattered wires, looks at her with confusion. He mumbles a thank you. She tells him it's reply paid. He attempts to sing a response but stops when she says he doesn't have to. She begins dancing again, this time in a jerky, strained way. Sam checks his watch and asks if she isn't late—the party started half an hour ago. She admits there’s a backlog, everyone says the same. He says the performance was nice. She asks if she can use his bathroom.
related_events: Girl bursts in and performs song and dance routine
Sam and Girl exchange awkward greetings after performance

name: Sam Notes the Girl's Lateness and She Dances Strangely
description: After delivering her song and dance, the Girl stands quietly with Sam for a moment. Sam looks at his watch and tells her she is half an hour late—the party started at eight thirty. The Girl says she knows, it’s because of the backlog, and asks if the performance was all right. Sam says it was very nice. The Girl begins to dance again, but this time her movements are stiff and awkward, as if she is struggling to continue. When she finishes, she asks if she can use the bathroom.
related_events: Sam checks watch and notes Girl is late for party
Girl performs second dance in strained manner

name: Girl Asks to Use Sam's Bathroom After Singing Telegram
description: After delivering the singing telegram and discussing the delay, the girl stands quietly for a moment. She then asks Sam if she can use his bathroom. Sam remains at the door, the wires from earlier still scattered across the floor behind him, as the girl waits for an answer.
related_events: Girl requests to use Sam's bathroom

name: Kurtzman Processes Buttle File Amid System Malfunction
description: Mr Kurtzman sat behind his desk and reached for his In-tray, pulling out a file marked 'Buttle, Archibald'. Without looking, he turned on his T.V. console. A voice suddenly said, 'Turn around real slow, amigo.' He turned, thumped the console with his fist, and the screen flickered to a display of figures. He opened the file and began typing into the console. The T.V. emitted an alarm, flashing 'Error, error, error' across the screen. He pressed the intercom. 'Mr Lowry, will you step in here please?' No one came. He got up, opened the door, and asked the room, 'Does anyone know where Lowry is?' No one answered. He returned to his desk and entered more commands. The machine beeped frantically, then played the sound of horse whinnies followed by a voice saying, 'Admit you're whupped, you drygulching scum.' Kurtzman slammed the intercom again, shouting, 'Where the hell is Sam Lowry?!'
related_events: Mr Kurtzman turns on his T.V. console without looking
Mr Kurtzman accesses Archibald Buttle's file on the console
Mysterious voice instructs Mr Kurtzman to turn around slowly
T.V. console alarms and displays error message

name: Kurtzman Seeks Lowry Amid Console Malfunctions
description: Mr Kurtzman, frustrated by the erratic behavior of his console, presses the intercom and calls for Mr Lowry. When no one responds, he gets up, walks to the door, and looks out into the room where clerks are working at their consoles. He notices that Mr Lowry’s desk in the center of the room is empty. He asks the clerks if anyone knows where Lowry is, but no one answers. Mr Kurtzman closes the door and returns to his desk.
related_events: Mr Kurtzman calls for Mr Lowry via intercom
Mr Kurtzman discovers Mr Lowry's desk is unoccupied
Mr Kurtzman asks clerks about Mr Lowry's whereabouts

name: Hear Gunfire, Check Office, Resume Console Work
description: Mr Kurtzman hears the sharp sound of six guns firing at once. He quickly reopens the door to his office, looking out into the room of clerks hunched over their consoles, all silent and still, with no sign of disturbance. The central desk remains empty. He closes the door and walks back to his desk. Sitting down, he begins typing at the console again. The machine emits a series of frantic beeps, followed by the sound of a horse whinnying, then a voice shouting, 'Admit you're whupped, you drygulching scum.'
related_events: Mr Kurtzman hears the sound of six guns firing simultaneously
Mr Kurtzman reopens the door after hearing gunfire
Mr Kurtzman returns to his desk and operates the console

name: Mr Kurtzman Demands to Know Where Sam Lowry Is
description: The T.V. console emitted a series of alarming beeps, followed by the sound of horse whinnies and a voice saying, 'Admit you're whupped, you drygulching scum.' Mr Kurtzman's face darkened. He slammed his hand on the desk and shouted into the intercom, 'Where the hell is Sam Lowry?!'
related_events: T.V. console emits escalating warning sounds and taunting message
Mr Kurtzman shouts into the intercom demanding Mr Lowry's location

name: Sam Enters the Information Retrieval Lobby
description: Sam stands in the doorway of a vast, austere lobby, empty and devoid of decoration, with no crowds or security checks. He hesitates, then steps inside and walks across the open space toward the reception desk. A porter sits behind the desk. Sam approaches and says his name is Sam Lowry; he has come to report to Mr. Warren. The porter looks at his clothing, hands him an ID badge without inspection, and tells him the thirtieth floor, adding that he is expected. Sam, surprised, asks if the porter does not want to search him. The porter says no. Sam offers his ID cards, but the porter tells him there is no need. Sam, unsettled, says he could be anybody. The porter replies that he could not, because this is Information Retrieval, and indicates that the lift has arrived.
related_events: Sam hesitates before entering the austere lobby
Sam enters the austere lobby
related_occasions: Sam'S Arrival And Check-In At Information Retrieval

name: Sam Crosses the Lobby and Checks In at Reception
description: Sam enters the vast, austere lobby and walks across it, his movement tracked by a video camera. He comes to a stop at the reception desk, standing in tight profile. The camera tilts upward, revealing him facing a monitor on the desk, positioned directly in front of it.
related_events: Video camera follows Sam across the lobby
Sam stops at the reception desk in tight profile
Camera tilts up to reveal Sam facing the monitor
related_occasions: Sam'S Arrival And Check-In At Information Retrieval

name: Sam Reports to Information Retrieval and Offers Identification
description: Sam stands at the reception desk in the austere lobby and speaks hesitantly to the porter, saying his name is Sam Lowry and that he is there to report to Mr. Warren. The porter looks down at Sam's clerk's suit, then hands him an I.D. badge without examining any credentials. Sam hesitates, taken aback, and asks if the porter wants to search him. When the porter says no, Sam reaches into his pocket and offers his I.D. cards. The porter tells him there is no need. Sam, still uncertain, says he could be anybody. The porter replies that he couldn't, because this is Information Retrieval, and indicates that the lift has arrived.
related_events: Sam speaks diffidently to the porter about reporting to Mr Warren
Porter hands Sam an I.D. badge without inspection
Sam offers his I.D. cards for verification
related_occasions: Sam'S Arrival And Check-In At Information Retrieval

name: Sam is directed to the lift after being cleared by the porter
description: The porter looks down at Sam's clerk's suit, hands him an I.D. badge without further scrutiny, and tells him to go to the thirtieth floor, saying he is expected. Sam hesitates and asks if the porter wants to search him or check his I.D. cards, but the porter replies that there is no need, stating that this is Information Retrieval and that Sam could not be an imposter. He then indicates the arriving lift to the right, and Sam stands there, facing the desk as the monitor displays his image.
related_events: Porter reassures Sam that he cannot be an imposter due to the nature of the department
Porter directs Sam to the arriving lift
related_occasions: Sam'S Arrival And Check-In At Information Retrieval

name: Sam Wakes to Overheating Room
description: Sam lies in bed, thrashing and drenched in sweat. The air is thick and hot. He pushes against the tangled bedclothes, struggling to get free. He gets up and stumbles to the thermostat on the wall. He stares at it, then prods at the controls, but the display remains fixed at 99 degrees. The numbers do not change, no matter how he adjusts it.
related_events: Sam struggles with bedclothes during a night sweat
Sam discovers thermostat is stuck at 99 degrees

name: Sam Opens the Sealed Window
description: Sam entered the sitting room and went to the window, trying to open it. The window did not budge, held shut by screws. He went to the kitchen and returned with a knife, using it to remove the screws. Once they were loose, he swung the window open and took a deep breath.
related_events: Sam attempts to open sealed window in sitting room
Sam uses knife to unscrew and open window

name: Sam Seals Apartment Against Toxic Smog
description: Sam opened the window, and a thick greenish-brown smog poured into the room. He gagged, coughed, and quickly slammed the window shut, tightening the screws to seal it. Grabbing a newspaper, he swung it repeatedly to clear a path through the polluted air. Staggering forward, he reached the front door, opened it, and stumbled into the hallway, gasping for breath.
related_events: Toxic smog enters apartment through open window
Sam seals window against incoming smog
Sam clears air with newspaper to reach front door
Sam exits apartment into hallway gasping for air

name: Sam Calls for Help and Is Turned Away
description: Sam sits in his kitchen with the telephone directory open in front of him. He lifts the receiver and dials a number, speaking into the phone. He gives his location as Block 19, Northwestern Section D, near exit 1 on Green Pastures Highway at the Orange Blossom Flyover, and reports a problem with his air-conditioning. A recorded voice responds, stating that Central Services cannot take service calls between 2300 and 0900 hours due to a temporary staff shortage. Sam insists it is an emergency and demands to speak to a heating engineer. The voice repeats its message. Sam slams the phone down.
related_events: Sam dials Central Services for help with air-conditioning failure
Central Services automated response rejects Sam's service call
Sam slams down the phone in frustration after failed service call

name: Sam Seeks Relief and Breaks a Jar of Pickled Onions
description: Sam sits in front of his open refrigerator, a chair wedged into the door to keep it ajar, letting the cold air spill out. His eyes grow heavy as he leans against the shelf inside. His head slumps, knocking over a jar of pickled onions. The glass shatters on the kitchen floor, sending onions rolling across the tiles.
related_events: Sam uses open refrigerator and chair to stay cool while nodding off
Sam's head slumps against refrigerator shelf causing jar to fall
Jar of pickled onions shatters and scatters across kitchen floor

name: Sam Reaches the Platform with the Girl
description: Sam flies upward through the sky, his wings straining as he tows a floating cage containing the Girl. Below, monolithic stone skyscrapers recede into the distance. He arrives at a high platform perched atop a central column, surrounded by a vast expanse of tightly packed giant eyeballs, each scanning the sky. Sam secures the hawser anchoring the cage and removes his wings. He stands on the platform, the Girl contained within the cage above him, as the landscape of eyes remains watchful.
related_events: Sam tows floating cage with wings through sky
Giant eyeballs collectively scan the sky
Sam anchors cage and removes wings on platform

name: Sam Watches the Sky Break and Vanish
description: Cracks tear across the sky from beyond the horizon, splitting the heavens with sharp, deafening cracks. The fissures spread rapidly, forming a vast grid that stretches from one end of the sky to the other. One by one, massive square blocks of sky begin to slide upward, pulled out of view, leaving behind dark, empty holes that extend into blackness. With each block removed, the light fades. Sam stands frozen on the platform, unable to move as the sky above him vanishes. The girl in the cage cries out, but he cannot reach her. The grinding of stone on stone fills the air as more blocks disappear. The world darkens until only one square of sky remains. It too slides upward and vanishes. Total blackness falls. A beam of light cuts through the dark as Sam turns on a searchlight, sweeping it across the void. The sound of maniacal laughter echoes around him. The beam catches a flapping shape—black cloth surging downward—before it crashes over him.
related_events: Cracks violently fissure across the sky from horizon
Grid of cracks spreads across the sky and blocks of sky begin sliding upward
Sam freezes while sky blocks are removed and light diminishes

name: Sam's Failed Rescue in the Falling Sky
description: As the grid of cracks spread across the sky, the blocks of stone began sliding upward one by one, vanishing into darkness. The light faded with each block’s removal. The Girl cried out for Sam to save her. He lunged for the hawser and pulled at the cage, trying to lower it to the platform, but the mechanism resisted. The final square of sky slid up and out of view. Total blackness fell. A maniacal laughter echoed. Sam switched on a searchlight, sweeping the beam through the dark. The light caught a flapping black shape—cloth, vast and formless—before it crashed down on him, swallowing him whole.
related_events: Girl cries out for Sam to save her as sky disintegrates
Sam attempts to haul cage down to platform but fails
Final block of sky is removed and total blackness ensues

name: Sam's Searchlight Fails Against the Black Flapping Entity
description: After the final block of sky is pulled up and out of view, complete darkness falls. Maniacal laughter echoes through the void. Sam switches on a searchlight, casting a beam into the blackness. The light catches a large, black, flapping shape descending rapidly from above. Before he can react, the entity crashes down and engulfs him.
related_events: Maniacal laughter echoes and Sam activates searchlight in darkness
Final block of sky is removed and total blackness ensues
Black flapping entity engulfs Sam in darkness

name: Sam tries to put out the burning Messerchmidt
description: Sam charges out into the open air and sees the Messerchmidt engulfed in flames. Nearby, a group of children stand in silence, watching. Sam spots an old mattress lying by the building, grabs it, and throws it over the burning car in an attempt to smother the fire.
related_events: Sam charges out into the open air
Messerchmidt catches fire
Sam attempts to smother flames with mattress

name: Sam Sees Jill and Chases the Lorry
description: Jill's lorry rounds the corner at high speed. Sam sees her at the wheel and runs after the vehicle, shouting that the incident was not his doing. The lorry continues on and disappears into the distance, leaving Sam behind.
related_events: Jill's lorry rounds corner at high speed
Sam identifies Jill at the wheel of the lorry
Sam chases after the lorry while shouting
Lorry departs scene at high speed

name: Sam finds his vehicle disabled and faces the silent children
description: After the lorry roars away, Sam runs back to his smoldering three-wheeler, throws himself into it, and tries to start the engine. The vehicle doesn't move. He gets out and sees that all three wheels have been taken. He slumps down against the charred frame in defeat. Turning, he notices the group of children standing nearby, watching him in silence. Among them is the little girl, Girl Buttle. He looks at them, saying nothing, and they return his gaze without expression.
related_events: Sam returns to his three-wheeler and attempts to start it
Sam discovers all three wheels have been removed from his vehicle
Sam collapses against charred vehicle in defeat
Sam confronts children in despair

name: Sam Learns Girl Buttle's Name and Recognizes Her Significance
description: Girl Buttle stands over Sam in silence. Sam tells her to go away, then asks about Jill. The girl replies, 'Her name is Jill. Jill Layton.' Sam gets up and calls her a good girl, asking what she is doing there. She says she is waiting for her daddy. Sam walks away, then stops. He turns back and looks at Girl Buttle, who stands alone and still in the ruined lot.
related_events: Girl Buttle stands over Sam in silence
Sam questions Girl Buttle about Jill
Sam realizes connection to Girl Buttle

name: Sam Exits Elevator as a Strange Sound Approaches
description: Sam steps out of the elevator. The doors close behind him. He looks up and down the corridor, hearing nothing but silence. Then, a faint whirring, murmuring, tumbling sound begins to grow louder, coming from somewhere down the long hallway.
related_events: Sam exits the elevator and observes the silent corridor
Mysterious whirring sound grows closer in the corridor

name: Mr Warren Arrives Amid a Crowd of Expediters
description: A sudden commotion breaks the silence as a group of people rounds the corner at the far end of the corridor. At the center is Mr Warren, a tall man with a commanding presence, moving quickly with an air of constant motion. He is surrounded by a swirling crowd of Expediters, each waving papers or pagers, calling out to him. One holds up an order, another an invoice, a third mentions a victim's list. Mr Warren responds sharply—'Yes,' 'No,' 'send that back,' 'wrong department,' 'of course,' 'of course not,' 'maybe'—without breaking stride. As he passes, satisfied Expediters peel away and vanish through doors along the corridor. Others dart out from new doorways, joining the group with fresh requests. The noise and movement sweep past SAM, who stands motionless, unable to speak up. The crowd continues down the hall, growing fainter, until it turns the corner at the opposite end and disappears. The corridor falls silent once more.
related_events: Scrum of people emerges around the corner with Mr Warren at the center

name: Expediters Crowd Around Mr Warren with Urgent Requests
description: As the scrum moves down the corridor, Expediters wave pagers and thrust forward papers, calling out about orders, invoices, victim lists, and requisitions. They press in around Mr Warren, each trying to be heard over the others. Mr Warren responds with quick decisions—yes, no, cancel that, send it back—without breaking stride. One by one, satisfied Expediters peel away and disappear through the corridor’s doors, while others dart out from side doors to join the group, keeping the crowd constant as it sweeps past SAM and fades into the distance.
related_events: Expediters compete for Mr Warren's attention with documents and statements
Expediters voice urgent requests to Mr Warren while waving pagers

name: Mr Warren Moves Down the Corridor Amid a Crowd of Expediters
description: SAM steps out of the lift and stands in silence, listening. A distant whirring and murmuring grows louder. Around the far end of the corridor, a crowd of PEOPLE comes into view, moving quickly. At the center is MR WARREN, a tall man with a commanding presence, walking briskly. He is surrounded by EXPEDITERS who press in from all sides, waving pagers and papers, each trying to speak. One holds up a document and says, 'Mr Warren, this order—' Another interrupts, 'About this invoice—Victim's list—' MR WARREN responds without pause, 'Yes—no—send that back—wrong department—of course—of course not—yes—no—maybe.' As he passes SAM, more Expediters join from side doors, shouting new requests. 'About these requisitions—' 'EX/27 has 15 suspects still outstanding—' 'A decision, Mr Warren—' He answers, 'Cancel that—okay—put half as terrorists, the rest as victims—yes—yes—no—definitely no.' Satisfied Expediters peel away, vanishing through doors, while others rush in to take their place. The group surges forward, sweeping past SAM and fading down the corridor until it turns the corner and disappears. Silence returns. SAM follows.
related_events: Mr Warren responds to requests with rapid-fire decisions and instructions
Mr Warren issues rapid decisions to the Expediters

name: The Shifting Scrum in the Corridor
description: As the group moves down the corridor, Expediters who receive answers break away from the cluster and disappear through various doors into offices. At the same time, new Expediters rush out from other doorways, rushing into the group with papers and questions. The crowd around Mr Warren shifts constantly—some leave, others join—but the size and noise of the group remain steady as it continues down the hall.
related_events: Satisfied Expediters leave the scrum and enter corridor offices
New Expediters join the scrum from other doors

name: Sam watches the scrum pass without joining
description: Sam stands in the corridor as the group surges past him. He watches Mr Warren at the center, surrounded by expediters waving papers and calling out. Warren snaps responses, some expediters fall away, others dart in. The noise of voices and footsteps fills the hall, then recedes as the group moves down the corridor and turns the corner. Sam remains still, then begins to follow.
related_events: Sam observes the scrum with awe as it passes by
Sam decides not to intervene in the scrum

name: The Scrum Passes and Sam Follows
description: The group surges past Sam, a whirl of voices and motion, moving swiftly down the corridor. Mr Warren strides at the center, still issuing clipped responses as the expediters flutter around him. One by one, they peel off, vanishing through doors, while others dart out to take their place. The noise fades as the scrum rounds the far corner and disappears. The corridor falls silent. Sam stands alone for a moment, then turns and begins to walk in the same direction, following the path the group has taken.
related_events: Scrum moves past Sam and disappears down the corridor
Sam follows the scrum after it passes
Silence returns to the corridor after the scrum departs

name: Sam Confronts the Repair Crew
description: Sam enters his apartment and finds it in chaos—panels torn from the walls, wires and pipes spilling out, and two workmen hunched over confusing wiring plans. Spoor stands amid the disorder, directing the men. Before Sam can protest, a muffled voice echoes from inside the wall, repeating his own words. Spoor pulls out a small tape recorder and plays back Sam’s phone call to Central Services, in which he reported an emergency. He shuts off the device, slips it away, and produces a thin multi-page form with carbon paper, pointing to the bottom of the first sheet. Sam pulls out an old fountain pen and signs, but the mark barely shows through the carbon. Spoor frowns and asks if he has a ballpoint. Resigned, Sam begins signing each page. Spoor suddenly notices the silence from within the wall. He calls out, 'Dowser!' The panel behind him bursts open as Dowser stumbles through, dragging loose cables and holding a spare part that does not belong to Sam’s apartment.
related_events: Sam enters the apartment to find it in disarray
Spoor plays back Sam's emergency call to justify intervention
related_occasions: Emergency Repair Operation In Sam'S Apartment

name: Sam Signs the 27B/6 Form
description: Spoor handed Sam a 27B/6 form and pointed to the bottom of the first page. Sam pulled out an old-fashioned fountain pen and signed, but the mark barely showed through the carbon paper. Spoor frowned and asked if Sam had a ballpoint pen. Without comment, Sam began signing each page again, this time with a ballpoint, carefully making sure each copy was legible.
related_events: Sam signs the 27B/6 form with a fountain pen
Sam resubmits signature using ballpoint pen on all carbon copies
related_occasions: Emergency Repair Operation In Sam'S Apartment

name: Dowser Finds Tuttle's Spare Part
description: Spoor notices that Dowser has stopped making noise and calls out to him. Suddenly, Dowser bursts through a wall panel, tearing loose a section of the wall that sends pipes and wiring spilling into the room. Clutched in his hand is a spare part connected to a rubber tube pulled from inside the wall. He holds it up, revealing it to be Tuttle's component. Spoor and Dowser turn to Sam, demanding to know about Tuttle’s presence and where the part came from.
related_events: Dowser bursts through a wall panel with a spare part
Dowser reveals Tuttle's spare part attached to a rubber tube in the wall
Spoor and Dowser confront Sam about Tuttle's presence and the origin of the spare part

name: Workmen Accuse Sam of Sabotage and Abandon Repair
description: After Dowser bursts through the wall panel, dragging out a section of the apartment's wiring, he holds up Tuttle's spare part. Spoor examines it, then turns to Sam, accusing him of hiding Tuttle and sabotaging Central Services. Without waiting for a response, Spoor snatches the signed form from Sam's hands, tears it into pieces, and pockets the remaining pages. The two workmen gather their tools, exchange a few mocking words with Sam, and head for the door. They slam it shut behind them, leaving Sam standing alone among the exposed pipes and torn-open walls.
related_events: Spoor confiscates and destroys the form page from Sam's hands
Workmen abandon the repair job and exit Sam's flat in protest
Spoor and Dowser deliver a mocking farewell to Sam before leaving
Workmen slam the door leaving Sam alone in the damaged flat

name: Sam Collapses on the Couch Amid Apartment Ruins
description: Left alone in the ruined sitting-room, Sam sinks onto the couch. The apartment creaks and settles around him. He stares at a printout of Jill's face, the paper held loosely in his hand. His gaze lingers until the image seems to shift, her features blurring and reforming in his mind into that of the Dream Girl.
related_events: Sam collapses onto the couch in his damaged sitting-room
Sam stares at the print-out of Jill's face which transforms into the Dream Girl

name: Sam Lowry Delivers the Refund Cheque
description: Sam Lowry enters Mrs Buttle's dimly lit sitting-room and notices the hole in the ceiling. A woman sits motionless at a small table near a broken window. He asks if she is Mrs Buttle, and she nods slightly without looking at him. He introduces himself as Sam Lowry from the Ministry of Information and says he has come to deliver a cheque. He takes the cheque from his pocket and places it on the table. When she does not respond, he pushes it toward her and explains it is a refund due to an overcharge by Information Retrieval. He mentions the mistake is unusual and adds that the delivery is unorthodox, as payments are usually handled by the central computer, but difficulties arose and they wanted to avoid delay, especially with Christmas approaching. He points to the hole in the ceiling and asks what happened, but receives no answer. He then asks her to sign two receipts. He picks up the cheque and hands it to her along with the receipts. She tears them up and throws them in his face.
related_events: Sam Lowry enters Mrs Buttle's sitting-room and observes the damaged ceiling
Sam Lowry identifies himself to Mrs Buttle and presents a refund cheque
Sam Lowry explains the unorthodox delivery of the refund due to administrative difficulties
Sam Lowry requests Mrs Buttle to sign refund receipts

name: Mrs Buttle Asks About Her Husband's Body
description: After Sam explains the refund and mentions a mistake by Information Retrieval, Mrs Buttle quietly asks if her husband is dead. When Sam avoids answering directly and offers bureaucratic reassurances, she demands to know what has been done with his body. She begins to cry, refusing to be pacified. Sam hands her the cheque and the receipts, but she tears them up and throws the pieces in his face.
related_events: Mrs Buttle questions whether her husband is dead
Mrs Buttle cries and confronts Sam Lowry about her husband's body
Mrs Buttle tears up the receipts and throws them at Sam Lowry

name: Young Buttle Attacks Sam Lowry
description: The boy suddenly lunged at Sam Lowry with fierce intensity, knocking him hard against the wall. A mirror hanging there came loose and crashed to the floor, shattering. The boy kicked and pulled at Sam’s hair, overwhelmed with rage. Mrs Buttle rushed to intervene, pulling her son away with effort. When the boy was finally free of Sam, he collapsed into sobs, shouting through his tears. Mrs Buttle held him tightly, speaking loudly in an attempt to calm him. Sam remained on his hands and knees, breathing heavily, one hand touching his side as if in pain.
related_events: Young Buttle attacks Sam Lowry with ferocity
Mirror falls and smashes during struggle between Sam Lowry and Young Buttle
Mrs Buttle intervenes to pull Young Buttle off Sam Lowry
Sam Lowry ends up on hands and knees in pain after attack
Mrs Buttle loudly tries to quieten the crying Young Buttle after the attack

name: Sam Lowry Sees Jill in the Broken Mirror and Flees the Flat
description: Dazed and on his hands and knees, Sam Lowry looks across the floor at a shard of broken mirror. In its reflection, Jill's head and shoulders appear framed in the hole in the ceiling. She asks if he is alright. Sam grabs the fragment and shifts its angle, but the image vanishes. He searches the broken glass on the floor, trying to find the reflection again. He looks up at the ceiling, where only the empty hole remains. Mrs Buttle also looks up. Sam shouts for the vision to stop and then to return. Realizing what he has seen, he scrambles to his feet, dazed, and rushes out of the flat. Mrs Buttle shouts after him as he leaves.
