Jill asks Sam if he is alright through the mirror reflection

name: Raid on the Buttle Apartment
description: Security troops burst through the front door, smashing it open. Another soldier swings down on a rope from outside, kicks in the window, and enters through the broken glass. At the same time, a clean hole appears in the ceiling, showering plaster, and a fireman's pole slides through. Two more troops slide down the pole into the room. They immediately grab Archibald Buttle, force him into a canvas sack that covers him from head to waist, clamp a metal ring around his neck, and slide a metal bar up the back of the sack. His hands are cuffed to the bar, rendering him immobile. From another room, Girl Buttle is carried out and dropped into the lap of her screaming mother. A soldier knocks the toy machine gun from Boy Buttle’s hands, the soldier’s uniform identical to the toy figures the boy had been playing with moments before. The boy runs to his mother as weapons are pointed at them. Troops kick open doors to other rooms, searching and securing the apartment. A plainclothes official enters through the front door and begins reading from a document, reciting legal phrases about Council Orders, financial obligations, and information retrieval procedures, his voice blending into the background amid the commotion.
related_events: Security troops raid Buttle family apartment

name: Arrest of Archibald Buttle
description: Security troops burst into the apartment, smashing through the door, crashing in through the window, and sliding down a pole from a hole in the ceiling. They seize Archibald Buttle, force him into a canvas bag that covers him from head to waist, and fasten a metal clamp around his neck. A metal bar is slid up the back of the bag, and his hands are cuffed to it, immobilizing him completely. Within seconds, he is rendered a motionless, bundled figure.
related_events: Buttle is captured and restrained in canvas bag

name: Troops Subdue Family and Secure Children
description: Security troops burst into the apartment and yank Girl Buttle from her bedroom, carrying her out and dropping her into the arms of her screaming mother. At the same time, a trooper knocks the toy machine gun from Boy Buttle’s hands, sending it clattering across the floor. The boy stumbles back, then runs to his mother as the troops swing their weapons toward the family, leveling their guns to keep them pinned.

Boy Buttle's toy gun is knocked away by trooper
Boy Buttle rushes to mother as troops aim guns

name: Security Troops Search Other Rooms
description: While the family remains restrained, security troops kick open the doors of the other rooms in the apartment. They rush inside, overturning furniture, tearing through closets, and scanning the spaces with weapons drawn. The sound of crashing and heavy footsteps echoes through the unit as they systematically search each room.
related_events: Security troops forcibly search other rooms

name: Official Delivers Detention Notice During Raid
description: Amid the chaos of the raid, a plain-clothed official steps through the front door of the apartment. As security troops smash furniture, kick open doors, and drag the Buttle family members away, he begins reading from a formal document. He announces in a steady voice that Mr. Buttle, Archibald, of 412 North Tower, Shangri La Towers, has been invited to assist the Ministry of Information with certain enquiries under Section 47, Paragraph 7 of Council Order Number. He continues, listing procedural obligations, financial restitutions, and central banking debits that may apply, citing forms, subsections, and legal stipulations. His words blend into the background as the family is overwhelmed, their belongings scattered, and Mr. Buttle, now fully restrained in a canvas sack with a metal clamp around his neck, is carried out.
related_events: Official reads detention notice during raid

name: Sign the Receipts
description: After Mr. Buttle is seized and sealed inside the canvas bag, a plain-clothed official approaches Mrs. Buttle, who is clutching her children. He places several receipt books in front of her and directs her to sign each one. Her hands tremble as she signs under the gaze of armed troopers still standing in the ransacked apartment. The official stamps each page, then hands her a final document—a receipt acknowledging the receipt of her husband. She looks at it without speaking, her face pale. The official tucks the signed books into his briefcase. The troopers, their boots heavy on the floor, file out through the broken door, followed by the official. The family remains behind, silent, surrounded by debris and the echo of forced entry.

Mrs Buttle signs for her husband's receipt

Mrs Buttle expresses anguish over her husband's disappearance
Troopers depart with the official after completing paperwork

name: Neighbors Peer Through Ceiling as Troops Respond
description: As the security troops finish securing Mr. Buttle in the canvas bag, a hole in the ceiling opens above the living room. Jill, one of the neighbors, looks down through the gap and sees Mrs. Buttle, still holding her daughter, her face streaked with tears. Jill calls out, asking if she is alright. Behind her, Bill and Charlie pull back from the edge of the hole, vanishing from view. In response, the security troops snap into defensive positions, raising their weapons toward the ceiling and aiming into the opening. The room falls silent except for the faint creak of the pole still swaying from above. After a moment, no further movement comes from the hole. The troops hold their stance, weapons trained upward, while the Buttle family remains motionless below.

Jill asks Mrs Buttle if she is alright

name: Sam and the Girl's Aerial Ballet
description: Sam Lowry flies through a brilliantly clear sky, his wings of wood and metal flashing in the sunlight. He wears a sleek outfit reminiscent of a retro-futuristic aviator. Nearby, a mysterious girl hovers in the air, her long hair drifting across her face, her form wrapped in soft, billowing gossamer that ripples like waves on the wind. She is the image of Jill Layton, radiant and ethereal. Sam glides toward her, and together they move in a graceful, flowing dance high above a vast landscape. The sun glows around her, illuminating the fabric that surrounds her as it rises and falls with unseen currents. Romantic music swells as Sam sweeps past her, then circles back. She extends her hand, beckoning. He flaps his wings, drawing closer, their movements synchronized in a silent, intimate rhythm.
related_events: Sam Lowry soars through the sky with birdlike wings
Mysterious girl appears as idealized vision of Jill Layton
Sam Lowry and the girl perform aerial romantic ballet

name: Sam and the Girl Separated by Rising Stone Skyscrapers
description: A brilliantly clear sky gives way to a surreal aerial dance as Sam Lowry, clad in ornate bird-like wings and a fantastical pilot’s outfit, soars toward a beautiful girl suspended in flowing gossamer high above a vast landscape. Her long hair drifts across her face as she floats, beckoning him closer. But the serenity shatters when the ground below erupts violently. A massive stone skyscraper bursts upward, surging into the sky with tremendous force. Another follows, then another, each a monolithic, windowless block rising in relentless succession. The girl is gradually hidden behind the growing forest of stone, her form obscured, then completely lost from sight. Sam flies among the towering structures, their sheer walls stretching endlessly above and below, the silence broken only by the creak of his wings. The open sky is gone, replaced by a cold, lifeless maze of stone.
related_events: Monolithic stone skyscrapers erupt from the ground
Girl becomes obscured and lost in stone metropolis

name: Sam confronts the procession holding the girl captive
description: Flying through the silent city of stone skyscrapers, Sam spots a dark procession winding through the narrow streets below. He dives down for a closer look and sees robed figures pulling heavy hawsers that arc upward to a large metal cage floating in the air. Inside the cage, the girl is held prisoner, wrapped in billowing gossamer that stirs as though caught in a constant breeze. The figures, cloaked and cowled, strain against the ropes, moving steadily forward. Sam positions himself at the end of the passage, standing in their path.
related_events: Sam Lowry dives toward the procession of dark figures
Forces of Darkness pull hawsers attached to a floating metal cage containing the girl

name: Sam Blocks the Procession Between the Skyscrapers
description: Sam dives down and lands in the narrow passage between two towering stone skyscrapers, standing directly in the path of the robed figures. The procession comes to an abrupt halt. The figures draw their swords, the blades glinting in the harsh light, and throw back their cowls to reveal grotesque, rotting faces. Sam remains in place, motionless and resolute, as the figures face him across the silent gap.
related_events: Forces of Darkness halt their procession upon spotting Sam Lowry
Forces of Darkness draw swords and reveal rotting faces
Sam Lowry stands defiantly between stone skyscrapers to block the procession

name: Sam Charges the Horde of Robed Figures
description: The robed figures twist grotesquely, their forms shifting as they raise weapons into the air, forming a dense mass ready to advance. Sam folds his wings tightly against his back and plants his feet firmly on the ground. Without warning, he lets out a piercing scream that shatters the silence. He lunges forward, charging headlong into the horde with no weapon in hand. The robed figures surge toward him, swinging their weapons wildly as the two forces collide in the narrow space between the towering stone buildings.

Sam prepares for battle by folding his wings
Sam unleashes a scream and charges the horde
Forces charge Sam with flailing weapons

name: Sam Overcomes the Horde and Is Halted by a Ringing Phone
description: Sam fought through the horde with fierce precision, disarming one attacker and seizing a sword. He moved swiftly, cutting down each opponent until none remained standing. As the last figure fell, the black, robed forms stirred again, rising from the ground as a swirling mass of flapping cloth. The shapes merged into a dark cloud that let out a shrill, laughing cry before darting away into the distance. Sam turned to follow, but a sudden, sharp ringing cut through the air. He froze, the sound of a telephone echoing around him, halting his pursuit.

name: SAM enters the giant eyeball and finds the Storeroom of Knowledge
description: SAM clings to a giant eyeball as it tumbles through space. He grabs the pupil for a handhold, and it opens like a hatch. He pulls himself inside, escaping the maelstrom. The interior is dark and cramped, bisected by a dividing wall with a thin sliver of light escaping from a narrow slit. SAM pushes against the wall, moving a section that reveals a small hatch. He forces it open with his shoulder, and it gives way with a metallic rasp. He tumbles through, barely catching himself as he lands on a high ledge. The ledge is the front of a massive wall made of countless file drawers. The wall drops away into a steaming mist far below. Other walls of files surround the vast space, stretching out like a towering city. Men ride window-cleaner platforms, moving up, down, and sideways along the walls, placing people dressed in period costumes into the drawers. Above, a platform descends toward SAM. A jolly man leans over the side, looking down at him. The man resembles MR HELPMANN from television. SAM climbs onto the platform. The man greets him by name and says they know everything there. He tells SAM this is the Storeroom of Knowledge, and that they can help him find the one he lost—if SAM agrees to help them in return. The platform begins to move along the wall of files.
related_events: SAM clings to a giant eyeball tumbling through space
SAM enters the interior of the giant eyeball

name: SAM breaks through a hidden hatch inside the eyeball
description: Inside the dark, cramped interior of the eyeball, SAM noticed a thin sliver of light escaping from a dividing wall. He pushed against the wall near the slit and felt a section give slightly. Realizing it was a hatch, he scrunched down and threw his shoulder against it. With a metallic rasp, the hatch buckled and gave way. SAM tumbled through, crashing into a new space as the world around him shifted suddenly.
related_events: SAM forces open a hidden hatch inside the eyeball

name: SAM emerges on a ledge overlooking the Storeroom of Knowledge
description: SAM crashes through a hatch and lands on a narrow ledge high up on a massive wall made of countless filing cabinets. He stumbles, nearly falling into the deep chasm below, but catches himself just in time. The ledge drops away hundreds of feet into a steaming mist. Around him, towering walls of file drawers stretch into the distance. Men move on window-washing platforms, gliding up, down, and sideways along the structure. SAM watches as they open drawers and place people dressed in various period costumes inside. The scale is immense, the activity constant and precise.

SAM observes attendants filing people in period costumes into drawers

name: SAM Meets the Jolly Gent in the Storeroom of Knowledge
description: A window-washer platform descends toward SAM, carrying a Jolly Gent who resembles Mr. Helpmann. Leaning over the side, the man calls out to SAM by name. SAM, startled, asks how the man knows him. The Jolly Gent replies that they know everything here, and gestures around them, explaining that this is the Storeroom of Knowledge. SAM climbs onto the platform as the Jolly Gent speaks of vast stores of human knowledge, experience, and thought, all filed away in the endless rows of cabinets. The platform begins to move along the wall. The Jolly Gent interrupts SAM’s attempt to explain his search, saying they already know why he has come. He offers help in return for SAM’s assistance, adding that the Forces of Darkness have won the day—but tomorrow is another one.

Jolly Gent reveals the location as the Storeroom of Knowledge
SAM boards the window washer platform with the Jolly Gent

name: SAM Receives the Sword and Helmet
description: The Jolly Gent pulls the Sword of Truth and the Helmet of Justice from one of the file drawers. He hands them to SAM, then drapes a cape over his shoulders, completing his outfit. The Gent helps SAM climb into the open drawer. SAM lies down inside and places the Helmet of Justice on his head, settling in as the space around him hums with quiet anticipation.

GENT presents cape to complete SAM's outfit
GENT assists SAM into the drawer
Sam puts on the helmet and lies down in the drawer

name: SAM fights the closing drawer as a samurai looms
description: The Jolly Gent begins pushing the drawer shut. As the drawer narrows, SAM's breathing quickens and he presses his hands against the edges, resisting. For a brief moment, the face of the Jolly Gent vanishes and in its place hovers the cold, metallic visage of a samurai warrior, its masked eyes staring down. SAM jerks back, panic surging, and throws his weight against the drawer, fighting to keep it open as the metal sides close in around him.

SAM sees a samurai warrior's masked helmet instead of the JOLLY GENT's face
SAM struggles to keep the drawer from closing

name: Sam Meets Jack After Security
description: Sam finishes passing through the security checkpoint in the vast lobby, where cameras scan faces and security officers monitor everyone entering. As he moves through the space, he runs into Jack, a former colleague. They exchange greetings, surprised to see each other. Jack says he’s doing well, mentioning his promotion to Security Level Five, his family, and his role working closely with Mr. Helpmann. Sam responds briefly, distracted. While they talk, a bank of television screens displays close-ups of people entering the building. One face—of a woman in overalls—catches Sam’s attention. He freezes, recognizing her as the girl from his dream, but the image disappears quickly. He looks around, but the woman now has her back turned and no longer seems familiar. Sam brushes it off, apologizes to Jack, and hurries away, realizing he is late. Jack calls after him, noting the time, and reminds him again that he’s falling behind.

Sam encounters Jack in the building lobby

name: Jack Meets Sam in the Lobby
description: Sam finishes passing through security in the building's grand lobby when he runs into Jack, who is on his way out. Jack greets him warmly and begins talking about his life, saying he’s now working in Information Retrieval, has reached Security Level Five, and is trusted more and more by Mr. Helpmann. He describes his career as going wonderfully, mentions his wife Alison is in great shape, his kids are fine, and that he has a beautiful home. As he speaks, a bank of closed-circuit TV screens nearby displays close-ups of people entering the building. When Jill walks in, the camera zooms in on her face, overexposed and frozen for a few seconds. Sam looks up and is startled—he sees the face of the girl from his dream. He scans the room to find her, but the woman in overalls now has her back turned in line at the information desk, and no one resembles the girl. He decides he must have imagined it. Jack notices Sam’s distraction and asks what’s wrong. Sam apologizes and says he’s going to be late. Jack checks his watch and agrees. Before Sam leaves, Jack tells him his life is going wrong and that Records is a dead-end job with no real security or chance for recognition. Sam interrupts, wishing him well and saying he’ll remember him to Alison and the twins. Jack corrects him—they have triplets. Sam reacts with surprise, then hurries away.

Jack warns Sam about his stagnant career
Sam misremembers Jack's children as twins instead of triplets

As Sam talks with Jack, he glances at the screens and sees the face of a woman that matches the girl from his dream. The image is replaced moments later. Sam looks around, startled, searching for the woman in the lobby. Jill has just entered, wearing overalls and standing in line at the information desk with her back turned, but Sam does not recognize her. He says nothing and breaks off the conversation, suddenly aware he is late.

name: Sam misses the girl and rushes off

Startled, he looked around the lobby, searching for the girl, but saw only Jill in overalls, standing with her back turned in the queue for the information desk. No one resembled the image he had seen. He decided he must have imagined it. Snapping out of his daze, he remembered he was late. He cut the conversation with Jack short, said a quick goodbye, and hurried away.

name: Sam walks past a surveillance demonstration featuring Jill
description: As Sam made his way toward the elevator, he passed a small group of men, some wearing lab coats, who were watching a salesman demonstrate a new surveillance system. The device automatically focused on people in the lobby, zooming in on their faces. One of the people captured by the system was Jill, who stood unaware in line at the information desk. The men observed the screen intently as the system locked onto her face, holding the image in a frozen close-up before moving to the next person.

description: Jill stands in line at the Information desk, clutching a set of forms. A small, radio-controlled surveillance camera hovers near her, circling closely and recording her movements. As she reaches the front of the queue, she hands her documents to the Information Porter and explains that she is reporting a wrongful arrest. The Porter tells her she must go to Information Adjustments. Jill hesitates, then says she was already sent back from there. The Porter asks for a stamped Arrest Receipt. Jill produces an unstamped receipt belonging to Buttle. The Porter refuses to accept the form without the stamp. Jill asks where she can get it stamped. The Porter does not answer but gestures for her to step aside. As she speaks, the surveillance camera drifts closer, hovering near her face. Frustrated, Jill swings the stack of papers at the camera, knocking it into the desk. It sparks, sputters, and falls silent. Nearby, a Salesman and two technicians react with alarm, examining the damaged device. The Porter, unfazed, repeats that she must return to Information Adjustments. Jill picks up her forms and steps away from the desk.

name: Sam Lands and Recognizes the Prisoners
description: Sam descends onto the barren landscape, his cape billowing like a parachute as he lands on the ashen ground. Before him, the Forces of Darkness drive rows of shrouded prisoners toward two massive cages suspended beneath misshapen balloons. Smoke and flames rise from strange mounds scattered across the wasteland, and the sky burns a deep red, lit from a sunless black disc. As the prisoners shuffle forward, one of the black-robed guards suddenly stops, spear raised, and turns toward the newcomer. Others follow his gaze. Sam stands still, taking in the scene, until his eyes fall on the faces of the captives. He recognizes Mrs Buttle, then others from the flats, and the children. His expression hardens. He draws his sword and steps forward.

From the rift, brilliant rays of light shot upward, and a large black flapping creature burst out with a shriek, soaring high into the blood-red sky. Sam peered into the opening and saw fluffy white clouds moving beneath the earth's surface, lit by a beautiful blue sky. Before he could react, a massive figure emerged from the depths, straddling the crack in the earth. The Giant Samurai Warrior, encased in armor made of computer parts and wearing a steel mask, stood over twelve feet tall, holding an evil-looking spear. He raised the weapon slowly, then vanished with a poof. The light from below disappeared as the crevasse sealed shut, leaving Sam standing alone, frozen in place.

He sprinted toward it, drew his sword, and began slashing at the thick ropes binding it to the earth. One by one, the tethers snapped. As the final rope parted, the cage lurched upward, pulling Sam with it. He rose rapidly, the ground falling away beneath him—until something seized his leg. His ascent stopped abruptly. He hung suspended, caught between the earth and the sky, as the cage swayed above him.

He is panicked, insisting someone will blame them when the mistake is discovered. Sam remains calm, studying the cheque and recognizing it as an official Ministry document.
